faqs.q: Sec. 38-215. - Certification to the county treasurer.
faqs.a:
If the owner of record fails to pay the amount specified in the statement of costs,
               the city clerk may certify the amount due and owing to the county treasurer for collection
               of the assessment. The county treasurer shall collect the assessment, together with
               a ten percent penalty for the cost of collection, in the same manner as other taxes
               are collected.
(Ord. No. 4095, § 4, 11-19-2007)
